sn9.12:0.2: On one occasion a certain bhikkhu was dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.12:1.1: On one occasion a certain bhikkhu was dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.12:1.2: Then the devatā that inhabited that woodland thicket  approached that bhikkhu and recited this verse in his presence:
sn9.12:2.2: And the birds have settled down,
sn9.12:2.4: How fearful that appears to me!”
sn9.12:3.1: [The bhikkhu: ]  “When the noon hour sets in,
sn9.12:3.2: And the birds have settled down,
sn9.12:3.4: How delightful that appears to me!”
